# criblio_search_monitors (Data Source)

Returns all matching objects in `items`, following API pagination automatically. Scope the request using the required attributes below. An empty collection returns an empty list.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "criblio_search_monitors" "example" {
}
```

## Schema

### Read-Only

- `items` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items))

<a id="nestedatt--items"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items`

Read-Only:

- `description` (String) Optional description of what this alert Monitor does.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether this alert Monitor is currently enabled.
- `firing_after` (Integer) Number of seconds the alert Monitor needs one or more firing instances before it is considered firing.
- `id` (String) Unique identifier for the alert Monitor.
- `is_default` (Boolean) Whether this is a built-in System Insights monitor. Cribl prevents deletion of default monitors.
- `name` (String) User-friendly name for the alert Monitor.
- `notification_policies` (List of String) List of notification policy IDs attached to this Monitor.
- `notifications_enabled` (Boolean) Whether notifications are enabled for this alert Monitor.
- `ok_after` (Integer) Number of seconds the alert Monitor needs no firing instances before it is considered ok.
- `params` (String) Use jsonencode with a map of string, number, or boolean query parameters.
- `product` (String) Product that owns the alert Monitor.
- `query` (String) Use jsonencode with a PromQL string or a structured query object. Structured queries use the API keys metricName, labelFilters, timeRange, and operation.
- `rules` (Attributes List) Rules that evaluate the query result and set alert severity. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items--rules))
- `schedule_interval_seconds` (Integer) Interval in seconds at which the alert Monitor is evaluated.
- `silences` (List of String) List of alert silence IDs attached to this Monitor.
- `sql_override` (Attributes) SQL queries for deployments with the custom monitor SQL override feature enabled. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items--sql_override))

<a id="nestedatt--items--rules"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items.rules`

Read-Only:

- `conditions` (Attributes List) Conditions for evaluating the rule against the value from the query results. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items--rules--conditions))
- `excluded_tags` (String) Tags to exclude in the rule filter. A map where each key can have an array of string values for matching. Tags are matched using an OR operation within each key and an AND operation across keys. Type: - object with string keys and string array values.
- `included_tags` (String) Tags to include in the rule filter. A map where each key can have an array of string values for matching. Tags are matched using an OR operation within each key and an AND operation across keys. Type: - object with string keys and string array values.
- `name` (String) User-friendly name of the rule.
- `show_on_chart` (Boolean) Whether to visualize the rule on the chart.

<a id="nestedatt--items--rules--conditions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items.rules.conditions`

Read-Only:

- `condition` (String) Use jsonencode with the condition type and its value, threshold, or range.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the condition is enabled.
- `labels` (Map of String) Labels added to the alert Monitor instance when the condition is met.

<a id="nestedatt--items--sql_override"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items.sql_override`

Read-Only:

- `instant` (String) SQL query used for instant (point-in-time) evaluation.
- `range` (String) SQL query used for range evaluation.
